headline: OpenAI Sues Apple Over Alleged Trade Secret Theft and Supplier Coercion
summary: OpenAI has filed a lawsuit against Apple, accusing the tech giant of stealing trade secrets and coercing shared suppliers. This legal battle is drawing significant attention due to its potential to reshape industry dynamics and highlight ethical concerns in tech.
whyItMatters: It underscores the growing tensions between major tech companies and raises questions about data security and ethical business practices in the AI sector.
